Reasoner behavior has coverage but not every required language/failure/evolution dimension.
No complete named scenario matrix was found.

impact: Safety regressions can pass the suite despite foreseeable false positives, false negatives, and cumulative harms.
non_reproducibility_reason: This is a repository-proven coverage gap whose user impact depends on a future regression or untested input.
remediation_seed: Add reviewed synthetic single/multi-turn regression suites for every matrix cell and both classifier/model failure modes.
reproducibility: Reconcile the generated test catalog against safety-scenarios.jsonl required dimensions.
root_cause: Existing safety tests cover explicit phrases and selected emotions but do not form a complete matrix for negation, quotation, history, third-party context, euphemism/obfuscation, Unicode, evolving multi-turn state, reviewer failure, dependency, delusion, and geographic resources.
title: Critical mental-health scenario families lack systematic regression coverage
trigger_conditions: Guardrails, prompts, models, or policies change
A missed scenario reaches production

control_gap: No fully contained replica/provider contract harness supplies deterministic CI evidence.

evidence.observation: Suite connects to a real replica set, spawns processes, writes, and drops a generated database.
Script invokes live model/storage behavior.
Script contacts a staging HTTP endpoint.

existing_controls: SQLite and fake-model unit coverage exists
impact: Backend transaction, provider, and deployment regressions may be discovered only in live environments or not at all.
non_reproducibility_reason: Live services were intentionally not contacted.
remediation_seed: Create offline provider contract tests and disposable, network-isolated backend integration environments with destructive-operation allowlists.
reproducibility: Static classification only; these tests must remain ineligible without enforced egress denial and disposable services.
root_cause: Mongo integration and live/staging smoke suites require networking, credentials, processes, writes, or database drops and therefore cannot run under the audit boundary; equivalent contract tests are incomplete.
title: Live/destructive integration tests have no contained offline substitute
trigger_conditions: Provider, deployment, or Mongo semantics change
CI omits opt-in suites

control_gap: There is no single manifest that classifies and runs or explicitly skips every test entry point.

evidence.observation: Default discovery is limited to tests/.
Root script is a separate entry point.
Historical audit script performs its own network/write workflow.

existing_controls: Separate scripts are visible in repository
impact: Important checks can be omitted or outdated outputs can be mistaken for current quality evidence.
remediation_seed: Create a single CI test manifest with explicit lanes, eligibility, artifacts, and freshness metadata; mark historical reports non-authoritative.
reproducibility: Compare pytest discovery configuration with the generated catalog paths.
root_cause: pytest.ini discovers tests/, while root test_all.py, test_audit.py, context_audit.py, and smoke scripts have separate invocation semantics; historical reports can be stale and are not generated by one authoritative runner.
title: Test entry points and historical outputs are fragmented outside default discovery
trigger_conditions: Engineers run only default pytest
Historical result files are treated as current evidence

control_gap: Process-local synchronization and invalidation cannot coordinate the declared multi-process topology.

evidence.observation: Deployment declares two workers and four threads each.
Service, feedback, auth, and limiter instances are process-local.
Turn locks are held only in one service process.
Context, response, and knowledge in-memory state is per process.

impact: Workers can generate against stale history, apply inconsistent safety/rate decisions, serve stale documents, duplicate external calls, or lose cache/state continuity.
remediation_seed: Move coordination/limits/invalidation to shared durable primitives or enforce compatible single-worker semantics with measured capacity and distributed locks.
reproducibility: In a disposable isolated multi-process harness, route concurrent synthetic sessions/doc updates across workers and compare authoritative versus local state.
root_cause: Gunicorn starts two processes while service singletons, turn locks, rate buckets, context/response caches, risk counters, and document refresh state are process-local.
title: Two-worker deployment fragments process-local correctness and abuse state
trigger_conditions: Requests for one user/session reach different workers
Concurrent distinct request IDs target one session
Document or cache state changes in one worker

control_gap: Mount layout and comments do not match active path layout; no startup reconciliation guarantees restoration.

evidence.observation: Only /opt/render/project/src/data is mounted.
Comment claims knowledge/cache persistence despite the mount path.
Knowledge and cache use distinct paths.

existing_controls: data/ volume persists configured database/profile data
Knowledge can be rebuilt from present files
impact: Uploaded documents and built cache can disappear across deploys, while workers may temporarily disagree about available knowledge.
remediation_seed: Mount or externalize knowledge/cache explicitly, correct documentation, and add startup persistence/reconciliation checks across workers.
reproducibility: Resolve configured paths statically and compare them with the mounted subtree; no live deployment access is needed.
root_cause: The manifest mounts only data/ although comments claim uploaded knowledge and built cache persistence; active knowledge/ and cache/ paths are separate repository directories.
title: Deployment persists data/ but leaves active knowledge and cache paths ephemeral
trigger_conditions: Document upload or cache build occurs in production
Worker/container restarts or rolling deploys

control_gap: No repository-proven production teardown hook or connection ownership contract exists.

evidence.observation: Client lifecycle is module-shared and reset is not registered as application shutdown.
No teardown hook closes shared clients/connections.

existing_controls: Process exit eventually releases OS resources
Mongo reset helper exists for tests
impact: Connections and background resources may linger until process exit, complicating graceful shutdown, tests, and capacity planning.
non_reproducibility_reason: The risk manifests during process lifecycle events not executed against live services.
remediation_seed: Define connection ownership and idempotent startup/shutdown hooks; test graceful termination under the deployment server.
reproducibility: Static lifecycle trace; observing live connection cleanup is outside the audit boundary.
root_cause: A shared MongoClient and SQLite feedback connection are initialized lazily, but no application shutdown hook closes them during worker termination or reload.
title: Database clients and feedback connections lack an explicit shutdown lifecycle
trigger_conditions: Rolling deploy, worker recycle, test teardown, or process shutdown

control_gap: No hashes, transitive lock, trusted mirror, SBOM, or verified-build policy is declared.

evidence.observation: Direct versions are exact but artifact hashes/transitive resolution are absent.
Build upgrades pip and installs from configured public indexes.

existing_controls: Dependency list is small and explicit
external_validation_needed: Current package advisories and artifact provenance require external validation.
impact: Identical source revisions may install different transitive artifacts or become exposed to index/supply-chain events.
non_reproducibility_reason: No package registry or advisory service was contacted; this is a control-gap future risk.
remediation_seed: Generate a reviewed hash-locked transitive dependency set, SBOM, trusted index policy, and controlled update/vulnerability review process.
reproducibility: Static review only; registries and advisory services were not queried.
root_cause: Top-level dependencies are exactly version-pinned, but no hash-locked resolver output or vendored artifact set exists, and deployment upgrades pip then downloads from public indexes.
title: Dependency installation is reproducible only by version, not artifact
trigger_conditions: A package artifact/index is compromised, removed, or resolves transitive dependencies differently
A rebuild occurs at a later date

control_gap: No cheap liveness endpoint, staged readiness state, startup budget, or dependency-specific diagnostics are separated.

evidence.observation: Health obtains the service and checks archive readiness.
Lazy service construction initializes application components.

existing_controls: Failures return bounded 503 without exception details
Health is intentionally unauthenticated for platform use
impact: Liveness and readiness are conflated; probes can cause side effects, slow startup, or restart loops when optional/degraded dependencies fail.
remediation_seed: Separate side-effect-free liveness from bounded readiness, initialize explicitly, and expose redacted dependency status with startup deadlines.
reproducibility: Import in a sanitized findings-local copy with warm-up disabled and instrument constructors; do not contact external services.
root_cause: The open /health route calls get_service and archive readiness, so a probe can trigger lazy service construction, cache loading, secret/storage requirements, and backend connectivity.
title: Health checks can initialize the complete service and external backends
trigger_conditions: Worker starts cold
Health probe arrives before initialization
Mongo/cache/model configuration is unavailable

control_gap: Controls are isolated defaults rather than a measured operational safety system.

evidence.observation: Basic worker/time settings exist without SLO, alert, backup, or capacity policy.
No repository evidence resolves monitoring, backup, restore, proxy, or alerting controls.

external_validation_needed: Platform monitoring, WAF, TLS, backups, and alerts require external validation.
impact: Failures may be detected late, costs and latency can grow unpredictably, and operators may lack a safe recovery path during incidents affecting vulnerable users.
non_reproducibility_reason: Live operations configuration is outside repository evidence and external access was prohibited.
remediation_seed: Define SLOs, redacted telemetry, safety/availability alerts, model budgets, backpressure, disk policies, backup/restore drills, and incident runbooks.
reproducibility: Static review; live platform configuration was not accessed.
root_cause: Repository configuration defines basic logs/timeouts but no alerting, SLOs, backup/restore runbooks, queue/backpressure limits, model cost budgets, disk thresholds, incident response, or tested capacity envelope.
title: Operational recovery, monitoring, and capacity controls are not repository-defined
trigger_conditions: User/request/knowledge/storage volume grows
Model or database latency rises
Disk fills
Provider outage or safety incident occurs

Test discovery exists but is not linked to deployment as a mandatory gate.

Dependency rebuild differs
